### Pre Battle Approach
As we ride in our airship, the sun barely cresting over the mountains, maybe 5am, you feel yourselves be awakened by blaring alarms.
The voice of Brakk echoes through the airship as his heavy fist slams on the metal doorways of the rooms, "WAKE UP, UP UP UP! WAR STARTED WITHOUT US, ITS NOT GONNA END WITHOUT US!"
He makes his way down the hall stopping at your room and stands at attention for a moment, "30 minutes till we reach the target area Generals. Mervin is up top, he has a scouting report for you as well." "I don't mean to rush you Generals but you should hurry."
He bows slightly and makes his way down the hall again shouting in his drill instructor voice, "CMON MEN WHO'S READY TO DIE?"

You all get up and get your armor on holster your weapons, splash some water on your faces and briskly make your way to the top deck. You feel the wind whipping and biting around you, a cold long winter day for a battle. The ship is alive with activity, soldiers and deckhands working, pulling ropes and masts and loading ballista's, people bow to you as you walk past, recognizing their generals. 
Mervin is at the wheel of the ship, arms crossed behind his back. Beside him manning the steering wheel is Damascus, the master airship engineer sent from Drok Shah. As you all make your way up the stairs he nods to you, "And a good day to my general friends! Do you feel it? The vibration, she is swift today, good for fighting."

Mervin nods to you all, his helmet on his hip, his scarred face open to the rising sun. "It's early for you all, I heard you tent to roll out of bed at 9, not Emrys, that's Hyperion Knight discipline right there."
